verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm a working llms.txt at code.claude.com, which hosts the Skills docs. Docs pages are served as markdown (e.g. skills.md) with a header pointing agents to the llms.txt documentation index, and the Agent Skills spec and platform guide are also published as .md. Skills content itself is agent-oriented markdown (SKILL.md) that agents and third-party tooling consume directly. missing for 10: a Skills-specific llms.txt (the probed one covers Claude Code docs broadly), independent hands-on reports of agents consuming these docs.
